react-async-state.solution: Use useEffect cleanup or conditional rendering with optional chaining
react-async-state.code_example: useEffect(() => { let mounted = true; fetchData().then(data => { if (mounted) setState(data); }); return () => { mounted = false; }; }, []);

postgres-connection-timeout.cause: Missing DATABASE_URL or connection pool exhaustion
postgres-connection-timeout.solution: Check .env file, verify DATABASE_URL, implement connection pooling
postgres-connection-timeout.code_example: const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, max: 20 });

playwright-timeout.cause: Element not found or page load timeout
playwright-timeout.solution: Increase timeout or use waitForSelector with proper selectors
